articles.title: A new flying drone uses touch to perch like a bird
articles.snippet: The drone's human-inspired fingers use touch to get a grip. This avoids some obstacles that come with relying on vision to perch.
articles.summary: A new flying drone uses human-inspired fingers and touch to get a grip and perch like a bird. This touch-based method avoids some obstacles that come with relying on vision.

articles.title: Experiment: Construct and test paper rockets
articles.snippet: Ready for take-off? Build your own rockets with paper, tape and straws. Then, take a deep breath and launch them with your lungs!
articles.summary: You can build your own rockets using paper, tape, and straws. Then, you can launch them into the air by blowing into them with your lungs.
